questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Which of the following physical quantities has the dimensional formula [M L² T⁻¹]?
questions.explanation: Angular momentum L = mvr gives [M][LT⁻¹][L] = [M L² T⁻¹]. Planck's constant shares the same dimensions.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 1: Units and Measurements

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: For a projectile launched from the ground with a fixed speed, the horizontal range is maximum at an angle of projection of:
questions.explanation: R = u² sin 2θ / g is maximum when sin 2θ = 1, that is 2θ = 90°, so θ = 45°.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 3: Motion in a Plane

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A charged particle moving with velocity v enters a uniform magnetic field B parallel to the field. The force experienced by it is:
questions.explanation: F = qvB sin θ. When the velocity is parallel to B, θ = 0 and sin θ = 0, so the magnetic force vanishes and the particle keeps moving in a straight line.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 4: Moving Charges and Magnetism

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: For an exothermic reaction carried out at constant pressure, the sign of ΔH is:
questions.explanation: An exothermic reaction releases heat to the surroundings, so the enthalpy of the products is lower than that of the reactants and ΔH is negative.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.question: Dimethyl ether and ethanol are related to each other as:
questions.explanation: Both have the formula C₂H₆O but different functional groups, an ether and an alcohol, so they are functional isomers.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 8: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following disaccharides is a non-reducing sugar?
questions.explanation: In sucrose both anomeric carbons of glucose and fructose are involved in the glycosidic linkage, so no free aldehyde or keto group is left.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Vascular bundles in a monocot stem are:
options: Conjoint, open and arranged in a ring
questions.explanation: Monocot stems have scattered vascular bundles that lack cambium, so they are closed and show no secondary growth.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 6: Anatomy of Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In a DNA double helix, adenine pairs with thymine through how many hydrogen bonds?
questions.explanation: A pairs with T by two hydrogen bonds and G pairs with C by three, which is why GC-rich DNA is more stable.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 5: Molecular Basis of Inheritance

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: In a resting muscle, the active sites on actin filaments are masked by:
questions.explanation: Tropomyosin covers the myosin-binding sites on actin. Calcium binds troponin, shifting tropomyosin aside so cross bridges can form.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 17: Locomotion and Movement

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Ovulation in the human female is triggered by a sharp surge of which hormone?
questions.explanation: A rapid LH surge around the 14th day of the menstrual cycle ruptures the Graafian follicle and releases the secondary oocyte.
